svg.title: Path from Tehran to Vienna
svg.desc: 2016: B.Sc., Mechanical Engineering, K. N. Toosi University of Technology (2016 to 2020). 2020: M.Sc., Mechanical Engineering, Sharif University of Technology, state estimation and sensor fusion (2020 to 2023). 2023: PhD & University Assistant, TU Wien, offline rl, off-policy evaluation, language models (PhD since 2023). 2025: Researcher, EU-TRAINS, Ludwig Boltzmann Institute for Digital Health and Patient Safety (Feb 2025 to Apr 2026). Now: Researcher, Medical University of Vienna, anaesthesia and intensive care medicine (Since Jul 2025).
